ask_open.name: Pink Bunny
ask_open.text: A cold draft seeps through the hatch. If I open it, the moonlight will pour all the way down the shaft.
ask_open.speaker: left

ask_open.name: Pink Bunny
ask_open.text: They say moonlight drives the beasts mad... Should I open it anyway?
ask_open.speaker: left

ask_close.name: Pink Bunny
ask_close.text: Moonlight is flowing down the shaft through the open hatch. Close it again?
ask_close.speaker: left

opened.name: Pink Bunny
opened.text: Moonlight floods in. Somewhere below, a beast is howling...
opened.speaker: left

closed.name: Pink Bunny
closed.text: The hatch is shut. It's quiet again.
closed.speaker: left
